dataList.content:
Hooah... You're next. And the last one.
呼……现在只剩你这家伙了。
dataList.place:
Daguanyuan - Yihongyuan Interior
大观园 怡红院内

dataList.content:
How strangely confident you are, for someone who has failed to protect her master.
连主人都没保住，还敢这么理直气壮啊。

<He doesn't know that the Sinners can come back from death.>
<他不知道。罪人们可以复活。>

Well, now that I've claimed young master Baoyu's life, I should be free to clock out. There's no coming back from a crushed brain.
算了。既然取了宝玉少爷性命，我该就此抽身为妙。反正连大脑都被彻底搅碎了。

Real shame... Had he studied under my tutelage, he coulda almost matched me in skill.
哎哟……要是在我手下学过两招，兴许还能打得有来有回。

And the intruder disappeared from the room without another word...
话音刚落，那怪人便从鸿璐的房间中倏然隐去……

... and after a brief break, I revived the dead Sinners.
在片刻休息后，我复活了死去的罪人们。

Just who could've possibly sent him...?
到底是哪个家族……派来的呢……

Could be that Jia Qiu bloke from earlier. You saw the way he was glarin' at the rich boy.
是不是之前那个叫贾丘的家伙派来的？他的眼神依旧杀气腾腾的。

He wasn't the only one glaring daggers at Hong Lu, you know...
刚刚用带着杀气的眼神盯着鸿璐先生的也不止一两个吧……

Oi, you alright? If your brain's feelin' funny, ask 'em to turn the clock again.
喂，没事吧？你如果神志不清的话就让时钟再转一下。

No, it's just that this feels new to me.
不用了，我只是感觉有点陌生。

Whenever I was attacked in here, this building felt so... infinitely vast.
往日在遇袭的时候……只觉得这楼阁实在空阔。

But now that I'm here with all of you, it feels so crowded and alive.
但和各位在一起却是这么热闹拥挤。

And that's... funny how?
那……有什么好笑的？

Well... I imagine he's saying that he's happy we've got his back. To paraphrase.
哎……这不就是有我们在身边感觉很踏实的意思嘛。
